items.title: Float system specification sheet
items.label: Spec sheet
items.note: One-page summary of the float: the buoyancy engine, the sensing and power chain, and the descent–hold–ascent sequence, with the 3D CAD model and the system integration diagram. Written for the competition documentation pack.

items.title: Control state machine
items.label: Control diagram
items.note: The firmware laid out as states: initialise, sink, decelerate, hold, float, transmit. Shows which sensor drives each transition — Bar30 depth for the setpoint, the potentiometer for actuator position — and what goes to the OLED and back to the surface.

items.title: PCB schematic — ESP32 carrier board
items.label: Schematic
items.note: The full schematic: 12 V input through the MP1584EN buck converter, TB6612 motor driver for the ballast actuator, I²C to the Bar30 pressure sensor and the OLED, and the limit-switch and rheostat feedback lines back to the ESP32.

experiences.company: Payment Cards Group · Hong Kong SAR

items.title: Compliance Pipeline Showcase
items.label: Document
items.note: The single biggest milestone during this period was developing a closed-loop compliance pipeline in 6 weeks! Features a series of scheduled statistical tests which transform thousands of transaction data points into valuable insights which can be used by human complaints to make informed decisions about merchants. To what extent does this relate to engineering? Engineers are problem solvers. Whether I am building an underwater robot or presented with a compliance efficiency problem, I will work my best to develop an elegant and resource efficient solution to this issue.

items.title: Picture with Principal Engineer and CEO.
items.label: Photograph
items.note: I hold this picture very dearly because these two leaders marked the beginning of my journey as an engineer. They didn't teach me a lot of technical things, I was only 16 at the time I took this internship position, but it was under their leadership that I began to turn the raw knowledge from school into engineering products.
